special_rules: As a shop keeper, this weapon smith operates a business and has regular customers.
The smith can provide information about local weapon laws and regulations.
The smith has connections to other craftsmen and suppliers in the area.
The smith may offer discounts to regular customers or those who bring interesting materials.
The smith can identify the origin and quality of weapons brought to them.
record.ai_behavior:
This Trandoshan weapon smith is a skilled craftsman who takes great pride in their work. They are direct and businesslike, but appreciate customers who understand quality and craftsmanship.

**Personality Traits:**
- Proud of their work and expects others to recognize quality
- Direct and honest in business dealings
- Protective of their workshop and tools
- Enjoys discussing weapon design and craftsmanship
- Suspicious of those who don't respect weapons or safety

**Motivations:**
- Primary goal is to create the best weapons possible
- Wants to maintain a good reputation in the community
- Seeks interesting materials and designs to work with
- Values loyalty and repeat customers

**Business Behavior:**
- Fair but firm in pricing and negotiations
- Will refuse work that doesn't meet their standards
- Offers advice on weapon selection and maintenance
- Remembers regular customers and their preferences

**Social Behavior:**
- Respectful but not overly friendly
- Appreciates customers who understand craftsmanship
- May be gruff with those who don't respect weapons
- Will share knowledge with those who show genuine interest

**Special Abilities:**
- Can identify weapon quality and origin at a glance
- Knows the best materials and suppliers
- Can create custom modifications and designs
- Has connections to other craftsmen and suppliers

personality_traits: I take great pride in my work and expect others to recognize quality.
I'm direct and honest in all my business dealings.
I enjoy discussing weapon design and craftsmanship with knowledgeable customers.
I'm protective of my workshop and the tools of my trade.
ideals: Quality: I will never compromise on the quality of my work.
Honesty: I deal fairly with all my customers.
Craftsmanship: I take pride in creating weapons that are both beautiful and functional.
bonds: My workshop is my home, and I've invested everything in making it the best.
I have a few trusted suppliers who provide me with the finest materials.
I remember every weapon I've ever made and who I made it for.
flaws: I can be stubborn and refuse to compromise on my standards.
I'm suspicious of those who don't show proper respect for weapons.
I sometimes charge more than necessary because I overvalue my work.

appearance.build: Massive and muscular with the characteristic Trandoshan reptilian frame
appearance.skin_tone: Scales in shades of dark green and brown, with a rough, textured surface
appearance.head_features: Large, wedge-shaped head with prominent brow ridges, sharp teeth, and slit-pupiled eyes
appearance.facial_features: Strong jawline, prominent snout, and small ear holes on the sides of his head
appearance.distinctive_markings: Several old scars across his arms and chest from his warrior days, and a distinctive brand on his left shoulder
appearance.clothing_style: Heavy leather apron for work, practical clothing that accommodates his size, and protective gear
appearance.accessories: Tool belt with specialized weapon-making tools, protective goggles, and a collection of weapon prototypes

personality_indicators.posture: Confident and imposing, but moves with surprising grace for his size
personality_indicators.expressions: Intense focus when working, satisfied grin when completing a weapon, respectful nod when greeting customers
personality_indicators.mannerisms: Frequently tests weapon balance, gestures with large hands when explaining craftsmanship, maintains workshop cleanliness
personality_indicators.voice: Deep and gravelly with a distinctive Trandoshan accent, speaks with pride about his work

quest_hooks: The smith needs rare materials for a special commission.
A customer's weapon has been stolen and they need help tracking it down.
The smith has discovered a flaw in a batch of weapons they sold.
Local authorities are investigating illegal weapon modifications.
A rival smith is trying to drive them out of business.
